faq.q: How is EasyDonate different from us?

ezdn: EasyDonate triggers an alert only when a donor uploads a bank transfer slip for verification, and the funds are transferred directly to the streamer's bank account.
alertbox_org: However, we trigger alerts instantly when a donor makes a purchase, subscribes, or donates. Payment gateway providers like Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, or Ko-fi send us a Webhook event to display the alert in real-time.
This method protects the streamer's personal information, as the donor pays the payment gateway provider first before the funds are ultimately transferred to the streamer.

ezdn: EasyDonate's free tier only allows up to 10 donation alerts per month and may display ads on the donation page.
Please learn more about %EasyDonate's pricing here%.
alertbox_org: We are a non-profit platform. We charge zero platform fees. The only fees you incur are those deducted directly by your chosen payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi), which are entirely out of our control.
Because of this, our only source of revenue to maintain and keep Alertbox.org and tip-to.me running is through donations from our users.

disclaimer: We at AlertBox.org have no affiliation, partnership, or personal relationship with the management of EasyDonate.
AlertBox.org was created by a small group of passionate developers who share the same ideal:
"True innovation flourishes when knowledge is free"
Our intention in building AlertBox.org is not to destroy market competitors. We simply want to provide another alternative for everyone.
Built by humans, for humans, on Earth.

good_to_know.title: Deep FAQ
good_to_know.subtitle: Streamer Secrets
good_to_know.description: The hard questions about privacy, chargebacks, and fees that other alert platforms don't want to talk about.

insights.title: 1. How do I mask my real name on Stripe/PayPal?
insights.desc: Alertbox doesn't touch your money, which means your gateway handles the billing statement. To stay anonymous, configure a custom 'Statement Descriptor' or 'Public Details' on your Stripe/Ko-fi dashboard. Avoid using personal PayPal accounts, as they expose your email and real name to donors.

insights.title: 2. How do I protect myself from troll chargebacks?
insights.desc: Troll donations are a huge risk. Since Alertbox connects directly to your Stripe or Ko-fi account, you can enable Stripe Radar rules to block high-risk cards. We also recommend setting a minimum alert threshold and using our alert delay features to intercept offensive messages before they display on stream.

insights.title: 3. Can I self-host Alertbox to avoid all tracking?
insights.desc: Yes, completely. Alertbox is open-source. You can run the entire system on your own server or a free service like Vercel/Fly.io. This ensures that no third party (including us) can ever track your donors, collect analytics, or change terms of service on you. Your overlay, your code, your absolute control.

faq.title: Questions & Answers
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the most advanced stream alert platform on the market.

items.a: Yes, 100% free. We are a non-profit, open-source project. We charge zero platform fees. The only fees you'll ever pay are the standard processing fees from your chosen payment gateway (Stripe, Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee).

items.q: How does AlertBox protect my privacy?
items.a: Donations are processed through third-party payment gateways. AlertBox never sees your financial data. We only receive webhook notifications to trigger alerts. Your real name, email, and bank details are never exposed to donors.
We currently support Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, and FeelFreePay. More integrations are coming soon. Each gateway sends us webhook events when a donation occurs.
Absolutely. AlertBox is fully open-source under a permissive license. You can clone the repository, deploy it on your own infrastructure, and have complete control over your data and alerts.

items.q: How do I set up alerts for my stream?
items.a: It takes under 2 minutes: Create a profile, connect your payment gateway via webhook, customize your alert design, then copy the overlay URL into OBS as a Browser Source. That's it!

items.q: What makes AlertBox different from Streamlabs or StreamElements?
items.a: Unlike closed-source platforms, AlertBox is open-source, charges 0% platform fees, protects creator privacy through webhook-based architecture, and gives you full ownership of your data and alerts.

about.subtitle: About Us
about.description: Alertbox.org is a free, open-source, and private alert box designed for streamers. We believe that true innovation flourishes when knowledge is free.
about.mission_desc: Most platforms charge high fees or force you to disclose your personal identity to receive tips. We created Alertbox.org to give streamers a privacy-first alternative with absolutely zero platform fees. Your support alerts appear live instantly, while your funds go directly to your personal payment gateways.

values.privacy_desc: We never access your banking credentials or sensitive transaction data. We only process webhook events to trigger alerts on your stream.

values.open_source_desc: Our code is fully open-source and reviewable by anyone. You are in complete control of your data and overlay integrations.

about.team_desc: Alertbox.org was built by a small group of developers who wanted to support their favorite creators securely and privately. If you find our tool useful, please consider supporting the project to help us cover server infrastructure costs.
about.faq_question: If you don't collect any service charge, how do you survive?
about.faq_answer: We don't. Alertbox.org is not a commercial enterprise or a venture-backed startup. It is a public utility run entirely on volunteer contributions and personal pocket funds. We survive solely on donations from the streamers and viewers who use our tools to keep the servers running.
